settings.question: How long until my order arrives?
settings.answer: Digital files arrive by email within minutes of checkout, worldwide. Printed gifts are made to order: allow 5-8 days within the USA, or an estimated 2-3 weeks for international delivery.

settings.question: What's the difference between the poster and the canvas?
settings.answer: The poster is printed on museum-quality archival paper and arrives rolled, ready for a frame of your choosing. The canvas is printed on gallery-wrapped cotton canvas and arrives ready to hang.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Digital portraits are available worldwide. We offer fine art posters internationally, subject to the delivery options at checkout, in 12×18″, 16×24″ and 24×36″.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Shipping is calculated at checkout and shown before you pay, so nothing is added afterwards. Digital files have nothing to ship at all.

settings.question: Will I get a tracking number?
settings.answer: Yes. As soon as your poster or canvas ships we'll email you a tracking number so you can follow it right to your door.

settings.question: What does Skip the Line do?
settings.answer: It moves your order to the front of the day's queue, so yours is made ahead of the orders waiting in front of it. You can add it to any format at checkout.

settings.question: How is the digital download delivered?
settings.answer: By email, within minutes of checkout. You'll get a link to download your full-resolution, watermark-free portrait, and it stays yours to download again whenever you need it.

settings.question: What size should I print my digital download at?
settings.answer: Our digital files are high-resolution and look great from 8×12″ up to 24×36″. For the sharpest result, print at 300 DPI.
